conventions.window_file: windows/<eyeball_tier>_<video_id>_<a>-<b>.mp4 (stream copy, starts on the keyframe at or before <a>)
conventions.clip_file: clips/<id>.mp4 (frame-accurate libx264 crf 12 re-encode, audio kept; frame 0 = first frame with source pts >= label_window.start_s)
conventions.image_tier: measured by fv.bench.measure: low if luma < 55 or laplacian_var < 250; mid if luma < 90; else high. Confirmed by eye (eye_note).
conventions.kit_tier: clean = two distinct team kits; bibs = bibs over mixed shirts or one side mixed; none = casual clothes, no team kit
conventions.team_norm: lower-case, scores/dates/punctuation stripped, then aliases applied; train and eval must be team-disjoint (python -m fv.bench check)
